title: Qoder CLI Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest accepted by Qoder CLI at .qoder-plugin/plugin.json, with an undocumented .claude-plugin/plugin.json fallback. Authored from the official reference page and the Zod schema compiled into the shipped CLI; Qoder publishes no JSON Schema. Unknown properties are stripped by the client, so this schema is open.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: https://docs.qoder.com/cli/plugins-reference ; @qoder-ai/qodercli@1.1.47 bundle/qodercli.js (compiled Zod schemas, lookup arrays). Component paths must start with ./ per the CLI schema. lspServers and channels are recognized but not implemented and are ignored with a warning.

name.description: Unique identifier; non-empty and free of spaces. Kebab-case is recommended. The CLI defaults version to "local" and derives the name from the directory when the manifest is absent.

version.description: Semantic version. The CLI substitutes "local" at install time when absent.

license.description: SPDX identifier, e.g. MIT or Apache-2.0.

dependencies.description: Plugins that must be enabled for this plugin to work. A bare name resolves against the declaring plugin's own marketplace.

userConfig.description: User-configurable values prompted at enable time. Keys must match ^[A-Za-z_]\w*$.

settings.description: Settings merged when the plugin is enabled. Only the allowlisted key "agent" is kept; other keys are ignored.

lspServers.description: Recognized but not implemented in the observed CLI; warned and ignored.

channels.description: Recognized but not implemented in the observed CLI; warned and ignored.

component.description: A plugin-relative path, an array of paths, or an object map.

markdownComponent.description: Agent definitions; every declared path must end in .md.

jsonComponent.description: Configuration declared as a plugin-relative .json path, an inline object, or an array mixing both.

commandComponent.description: Command definitions: paths, an array of paths, or an object mapping command names to inline definitions.
